description: 把 image-refs.v1 图片集合转换成可直接进入 HTTP 响应的 gallery body。最常见接法是直接连接 crop-export.crops，先快速检查每张裁剪图是否正确。

description.zh-CN: 把 image-refs.v1 图片集合转换成可直接进入 HTTP 响应的 gallery body。最常见接法是直接连接 crop-export.crops，先快速检查每张裁剪图是否正确。
description.en-US: Convert an image-refs.v1 collection into a gallery response body. The most common wiring is crop-export.crops -> images so the cropped images can be inspected quickly.

save_location.title: Save location
save_location.description: Optional save location. Relative paths write to ObjectStore; absolute paths write to the local filesystem.

description.zh-CN: 相对路径写入 ObjectStore；当前系统绝对路径直接写入本机目录；留空时不额外保存 Gallery 图片。
description.en-US: Relative paths write to ObjectStore; absolute paths write directly to the local filesystem; leave blank to avoid saving an extra Gallery image copy.
